|errata_history={{Card errata/Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V)}}
This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V)]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-dsdbc-0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9319460b36d9e7accecf0d32799fc84256802ef7 commit 9319460] (23 June 2021).</ref>. First published 23 June 2021. Virtual Set 15 was released on 23 June 2021; the same face had been committed the day before, rotated (commit 30816d1). Text: '''Light Side:''' “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” '''Dark Side:''' “If Leia is about to be lost from a Death Star site, imprison her here instead (even if inactive).” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-dsdbc-1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 commit 2640d50] (20 April 2022).</ref>. First published 20 April 2022. The large GIF was remade from it on 11 June 2022 (commit 6894629), the image on this page. Text: '''Light Side:''' “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” '''Dark Side:''' “If Leia is about to be lost from a Death Star site, imprison her here instead (even if inactive).” '''What changed:''' the words are the same. No errata mark.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-dsdbc-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545 commit e9980f9] (11 December 2022).</ref>. First published 11 December 2022. Text: '''Light Side:''' “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” '''Dark Side:''' “If [Set 20] Leia is about to leave table (for any reason, even if inactive), imprison her here instead.” '''What changed:''' game text on the Dark Side: new or changed words “[Set 20]”, “leave table (for any reason, even if inactive)”; words removed: “(even if inactive)”; the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E1”.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-dsdbc-3">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba commit efc26cd] (29 December 2024).</ref>. First published 29 December 2024. Text: '''Light Side:''' “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” '''Dark Side:''' “Once per game, may ▼ a non-[Maintenance] Imperial trooper here.” '''What changed:''' game text on the Dark Side: new or changed words “Once per game”, “may ▼ a non-[Maintenance] Imperial trooper”; words removed: “instead”; the printed errata mark is now “E2” (was “E1”). It prints the errata mark “E2”. This is the current text.
